memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath. They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the Lord. — Josh 7:22-23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The messengers run to Achan's tent, and there it is — exactly as he confessed, buried in the ground. The stolen goods are dug up, carried out, and "spread out before the Lord" for all to see. What Achan had hidden in the dark is now laid bare in the open, before God and the whole community.

There is something powerful in that phrase, "spread out before the Lord." Achan had hidden these things, imagining they were safely his, out of sight. But nothing stays hidden from God forever. What we bury in secret is eventually brought into the open. The treasures Achan schemed to keep became the evidence of his ruin, exposed before everyone.

This is a solemn picture of how sin works. What we think we have safely concealed will one day be uncovered. Jesus said, "There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known" (Luke 12:2). We deceive ourselves when we think our hidden sins will stay hidden.

But here is where the gospel offers a better way. We do not have to wait for our sin to be dragged into the light against our will. We can bring it into the light ourselves, willingly, at the foot of the cross. When we do, we find not exposure and shame but the cleansing blood of Christ. The difference between Achan's uncovering and a believer's confession is everything: one leads to judgment, the other to grace. Better to spread our sins before the Lord in confession now, and find mercy, than to have them uncovered later in judgment.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are there things you are keeping "buried," hoping they will stay hidden?
2. How does the certainty that hidden things are uncovered move you toward honesty?
3. Why is willingly bringing sin into God's light so much better than having it exposed?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I would rather spread my sins before You now and find mercy than have them uncovered later. Give me courage to bring everything into Your light. Amen.
